name: National Scholarship Portal (Post-Matric Scholarship)
ministry: Ministry of Social Justice / Minority Affairs / Tribal Affairs

name: Karnataka SSP & Vidyasiri Food/Hostel Scholarship
ministry: Government of Karnataka — Backward Classes / Social Welfare Dept
benefitSummary: ₹1,500/month for 10 months (₹15,000/year) for post-matric students not in govt hostels + fee concession

name: PM-USP Central Sector Scholarship for College & University Students
PM-KISAN Samman Nidhi
benefitSummary: ₹6,000/year in 3 equal installments of ₹2,000 directly into Aadhaar-linked bank account
applyWhere: pmkisan.gov.in → Farmers Corner → New Farmer Registration or nearest CSC

name: PM-KUSUM Solar Agricultural Pump Subsidy
ministry: Ministry of New and Renewable Energy (MNRE)
benefitSummary: Up to 60% government subsidy on standalone solar agricultural pumps (saves ~₹45,000/yr in diesel & electricity costs)
applyWhere: pmkusum.mnre.gov.in or State Nodal Renewable Energy Agency

name: Pradhan Mantri Fasal Bima Yojana (PMFBY)
benefitSummary: Government pays ~85%+ of actuarial premium; farmer pays only 1.5% (Rabi) to 2% (Kharif) for full crop loss protection
applyWhere: pmfby.gov.in, CSC Centre, or Rural Bank Branch

name: Kisan Credit Card (KCC) Modified Interest Subvention Scheme
benefitSummary: Crop loans up to ₹3 Lakh at just 4% effective interest p.a. (saves ~₹15,000/yr vs market/moneylender rates)
applyWhere: Any Commercial / Regional Rural / Cooperative Bank or pmkisan.gov.in

name: NSAP Indira Gandhi Old Age Pension + Sandhya Suraksha Yojana
ministry: Ministry of Rural Development / Directorate of Social Security & Pensions
benefitSummary: ₹1,200/month (₹14,400/year) direct bank transfer for senior citizens from low-income / BPL households
documents: BPL Ration Card or Income Certificate

name: Indira Gandhi National Widow Pension / Destitute Widow Pension
ministry: Ministry of Rural Development / State Social Security Dept
benefitSummary: ₹1,200/month (₹14,400/year) lifetime monthly pension credited directly via DBT
applyWhere: nsap.nic.in or State Seva Sindhu / Nadakacheri / CSC Centre

name: Gruha Lakshmi & Shakti Women Empowerment Package
ministry: Dept of Women and Child Development, Govt of Karnataka
benefitSummary: ₹2,000/month (₹24,000/year) DBT to woman head of family + free non-AC state bus travel under Shakti scheme
documents: Ration Card (Antyodaya / BPL / APL showing family head)
applyWhere: sevasindhuservices.karnataka.gov.in or Karnataka One / Grama One Centre

name: Pradhan Mantri Ujjwala Yojana 2.0 (PMUY)
ministry: Ministry of Petroleum and Natural Gas
benefitSummary: Free LPG connection (₹1,600 support) + ₹300/cylinder targeted subsidy for up to 12 refills/year
documents: Self-Declaration of No Existing LPG Connection
applyWhere: pmuy.gov.in or nearest Indane / Bharatgas / HP Gas distributor

name: Ayushman Bharat PM-JAY + Senior Citizen 70+ Vay Vandana Card
ministry: National Health Authority (NHA), Ministry of Health & Family Welfare
benefitSummary: ₹5,00,000/year free cashless hospitalization at empanelled public & private hospitals (saves ~₹15,000/yr in family health insurance premium)
